conditions.meaning: Reports whether training verified the model bundle identity and the artifacts required for publication.
Reports whether the published Model is ready for consumers.

example.introduction: The TrainingRun controller wrote these conditions after verifying the model bundle and publication records.
example.nextCheck: Compare status.loadedIdentity with the training and artifact digests you expect.

conditions.message: Model bundle identity and publication closure are verified.

example.title: Model publication verified

narrative: If a condition is missing, inspect publication and failure status on the TrainingRun named by `spec.trainingRunRef`.

outcomes.guidance: Check status.artifactVerifiedAt for the verification time and status.loadedIdentity for the verified digests.
The same update sets status.phase to Ready. Check status.producerRef for the TrainingRun identity.
